short_bio: American novelist and short-story writer associated with modernist literature.
full_bio: Ernest Hemingway was an American novelist and short-story writer whose fiction is known for its direct prose, emotional restraint, and enduring influence on twentieth-century literature. Valois Media editions currently include The Sun Also Rises and A Farewell to Arms.
seo_description: Books by Ernest Hemingway available through Valois Media.

short_bio: American novelist and short-story writer best known for fiction of the Jazz Age.
full_bio: F. Scott Fitzgerald was an American novelist and short-story writer whose work examined ambition, class, identity, romance, and the promises and failures of the American Dream. Valois Media publishes an annotated edition of The Great Gatsby.
seo_description: Books by F. Scott Fitzgerald available through Valois Media.

short_bio: German novelist known for literature examining war, memory, exile, and survival.
full_bio: Erich Maria Remarque was a German novelist whose work confronted the human cost of war, displacement, and political violence. Valois Media publishes an edition of All Quiet on the Western Front.
seo_description: Books by Erich Maria Remarque available through Valois Media.

short_bio: Author and editor whose Valois Media work includes original fiction and editorial editions of twentieth-century classics.
full_bio: Michael A. Cook is an author and editor associated with Valois Media. His work includes the maritime suspense novel 42 & The Ocean Blue and editorial contributions to editions of The Sun Also Rises, The Great Gatsby, All Quiet on the Western Front, and A Farewell to Arms.

short_bio: Author, poet, and illustrator whose work includes Once Upon a Dream and original cover illustrations.
full_bio: Alexander Valois is an author, poet, and illustrator associated with Valois Media. He is the author of Once Upon a Dream and contributes original illustration work to selected Valois Media editions of twentieth-century classics.
